## About
Gino's Auto Body Shop, Matticoli Brothers, Inc., is a family-owned-and-operated auto body shop in Princeton, serving all of central New Jersey. Our mechanics and painters work to return your vehicle to pre-accident condition as efficiently as possible.
Major collision repairs are measured before and after, so we know the chassis is back to manufacturer's specifications. We mix all paints on premises, use a water based paint system, and are skilled at blending colors.
Drivers have given us a 4.9 rating across 162 Google reviews. We arrange towing, help with rental referrals, and are happy to answer any questions about your insurance company.

## Services
- Computerized Chassis Measurements: Our velocity computerized chassis measurement system analyzes major collision damage. We measure before and after repair to be certain the chassis is returned to manufacturer's specifications.
- Precision Frame & Unibody Repair: When necessary, the vehicle is anchored on a Chief frame machine and pulled until the chassis returns to pre-accident position. Welded panels are installed with high strength MIG or spot welders.
- Spray Bake Refinishing: Down draft booths minimize dust and overspray during color application, then the booth ovens bake the finish to aid curing. All paint is mixed on premises.
- Free Computer Written Estimates: Every estimate is written by computer. We also welcome inquiries for budget repairs.
- Insurance direct repair: We are a direct repair shop for a major insurance company, and we accept damage appraisals written for any insurance company.
- Towing Service: We arrange towing for local customers. Towing and storage charges due to other carriers are paid by us and added to the repair estimate.
- Rental Car Referral: We work with a national car rental company and can give you the telephone number of the closest office.

## FAQ
Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We accept damage appraisals written for any insurance company, and we are happy to help with any questions you have.

Q: How long does an estimate take?
A: The average time required is 20 minutes.

Q: What vehicles do you repair?
A: We service all foreign and domestic vehicles, from automobiles to light trucks.

Q: Can I get a rental car while mine is in the shop?
A: We refer customers to a national car rental company that offers free pick-up and delivery at our shop.
